about.en: HOT (HoloToken) is the token of Holo, the distributed hosting network for applications built with Holochain, an agent-centric peer-to-peer application framework. HOT was issued as an ERC-20 token on Ethereum at 0x6c6EE5e31d828De241282B9606C8e98Ea48526E2 in the project's 2018 crowdsale and is intended to be redeemable for Holo's HoloFuel.
